ground_truth: The change switches the zone.js dependency in `devtools/src/BUILD.bazel` (the `devapp` pkg_web) and `devtools/projects/shell-browser/src/BUILD.bazel` (the static files filegroup). It goes from `@npm//:node_modules/zone.js/bundles/zone.umd.min.js` to the workspace target `//:node_modules/zone.js`. That moves the packaged file from `./npm/node_modules/zone.js/...` to `./node_modules/zone.js/...`. The change updated the `<script>` tag only in `demo-standalone/src/index.html`. `devtools/src/index.html` and `devtools/projects/shell-browser/src/index.html` still reference `./npm/node_modules/zone.js/bundles/zone.umd.min.js`. In both the DevTools dev app and the production browser-extension build, that script 404s and zone.js is never loaded, so the zone-based Angular app fails to bootstrap or run correctly. The fix updated both index.html files to load `./node_modules/zone.js/bundles/zone.umd.min.js`.
